title: 第25章 法儒掌尊第26章 狐假虎威
content_zh:
;;
太学宫，儒门执法堂。
气氛凝滞，甚至，有些压抑。
四位掌令神色冰冷，故作严肃，不言一语。
上头有令，今天要故意找茬，没事找事，这不是为难人吗？
执法堂内，李子夜行礼后，直起身，面带笑容地看着四人，安静地站在那里，也不着急。
装吧你们，我就不信你们一直不说话。
果然，过了没多久，四位掌令中，一人冷哼了一声，开口道，“李子夜，你可知罪？”
“不知。”
李子夜微笑道，“晚辈何罪之有？”
“私用刑罚，殴打我太学宫的学子，这是重罪！”
又一位掌令开口，冷声道。
“殴打？”
李子夜笑了笑，道，“整个都城的百姓都可以作证，我只是正当防卫而已，何来殴打之说。”
“你的武学远在他们之上，明明可以点到为止，却不顾仁义下了重手，这不是殴打是什么？小小年纪，便如此心狠手辣，若不惩戒，未来必为祸患。”第三位儒门掌令开口，神色冷漠道。
“呵。”
李子夜冷笑，道，“照掌令这么说，假如有一日，外敌来犯我大商，占我领土，杀我百姓，而我大商只需要点到为止，将敌人吓走即可，这是什么道理？昨日，我可是清清楚楚听到那些人说，要打残了我，倘若我是心狠手辣之人，那几人已不是躺几天的问题。”
“巧言狡辩！”
第四位掌令冷哼，道，“国事，又怎么能和私怨相提并论，李子夜，本来唤你前来，只是为了小惩大诫，没想到，你丝毫没有忏悔之意，冥顽不灵，若不严惩，日后还不定惹出怎样的祸端，来人！”
“在！”

执法堂外，四位儒生走入，恭敬行礼道。
“请戒尺。”
第四位掌令平静道。
“是！”
四位儒生领命道。
不多时，四位儒生双手捧来戒尺，神色恭敬。
执法堂内，李子夜丝毫不见惊慌，目光看着四位儒门掌令，淡淡道，“四位，我不是太学宫的学生，即便要用审判，也轮不到太学宫，难道，如今的太学宫已凌驾大商律例之上，可以私自用刑了吗？”
“不得胡说！”
四位掌令闻言，神色都是一变，喝道。
这个罪名，可不是太学宫能够承担的。
“连大商朝的律例都没有规定，正当防卫是需要受刑，而太学宫却要因为自己学生品行的不端，强行将罪名推给他人，甚至还要动用私刑，太学宫，好大的权势，若我不是李家之子，而是普通的平民百姓，今日，是否就算被打死在这里，也无人敢说什么，如今的太学宫，在这都城当真到了一手遮天的地步了吗？”李子夜冷笑道。
“你，小子，不要信口雌黄！”
四位掌令越听越是心惊，脸上冷汗直流，沉声喝道。
顶不住了。
这小子伶牙俐齿，不好对付啊，这活可真不该接！
“打吧。”
content_en:
;;
Taixue Palace, Confucian Law Enforcement Hall.
The atmosphere was stagnant, even a little depressing.
The four commanders looked cold, pretending to be serious, and said nothing.
There is an order from above to deliberately look for trouble today. Isn’t this making things difficult for people?
In the law enforcement hall, Li Ziye saluted, straightened up, looked at the four people with a smile, and stood there quietly, not in a hurry.
Just pretend, I don't believe you have been silent.
Sure enough, not long after, one of the four commanders snorted coldly and said, "Li Ziye, do you know your guilt?"
"I don't know."
Li Ziye smiled and said, "What is the crime of this junior?"
"Using private punishment to beat the students of my Taixue Palace is a serious crime!"
Another commander spoke up and said coldly.
"Beat?"
Li Ziye smiled and said, "As the people in the entire capital can testify, I was just acting in self-defense, so why should I be beaten?"
"Your martial arts skills are far superior to theirs. You can obviously reach the limit, but you have no regard for benevolence and righteousness and you hit hard. What is this other than a beating? You are so cruel and ruthless at a young age. If you don't punish you, you will be in trouble in the future." The third Confucian leader spoke with an indifferent expression.
"Heh."
Li Ziye sneered and said, "According to the commander's order, if one day, foreign enemies come to attack my great merchant, occupy my territory, and kill my people, and my great merchant only needs to kill them to scare the enemy away. What does this mean? Yesterday, I clearly heard those people saying that they wanted to cripple me. If I am a ruthless person, it is no longer a matter of how many days those people lie down."
"Sophistication!"
The fourth commander snorted coldly and said, "How can state affairs be compared with personal grudges? Li Ziye, I originally called you here just to punish you with a small punishment. Unexpectedly, you have no intention of repenting at all and are stubborn. If you are not severely punished, you may cause some trouble in the future. Come on!"
"Here!"
Outside the law enforcement hall, four Confucian scholars walked in and bowed respectfully.
"Please give me a ruler."
The fourth commander said calmly.
"Yes!"
Four Confucian scholars took the lead.
Not long after, four Confucian scholars held the ruler in both hands with respectful expressions.
In the law enforcement hall, Li Ziye did not show any panic at all. He looked at the four Confucian leaders and said calmly, "Four of you, I am not a student of Taixue Palace. Even if I want to be tried, it will not be Taixue Palace's turn. Could it be that Taixue Palace is now above the laws of Dashang? Can I use punishment privately?"
"No nonsense!"
When the four commanders heard this, their expressions changed and they shouted.
This crime is not one that Taixue Palace can bear.
"Even the laws of the Great Shang Dynasty do not stipulate that legitimate defense requires punishment, but Taixue Palace has to force the blame on others because of the bad conduct of its students, and even resort to lynching. Taixue Palace is so powerful. If I am not the son of the Li family, but an ordinary commoner. Even if I am beaten to death here, no one will dare to say anything. Is the Taixue Palace really so powerful in this capital?" Li Ziye sneered.
"You, boy, don't talk nonsense!"
The four commanders became more frightened as they listened, with cold sweat dripping from their faces as they shouted in a deep voice.
I can't stand it anymore.
This kid is very sharp-tongued and difficult to deal with. I really shouldn’t take this job!
"Fight."
